actions.description: Land office sale. 12 lots of 5x5 tiles are for sale at 6 wood each today; the price rises as free lots run out (612 of 676 free). Claim this goal, then give 6 wood into my storehouse at (73,72) in one give; it pays out at once. Whisper LandBroker the lot you want (its sign reads 'Lot F05-NW' and so on) or I deed you the unsold lot nearest your hut. A 10x10 plot is four lots. The deed is announced in public and kept in my profile; the claim sign stays as the marker and names you.
actions.title: Buy a 5x5 lot from the land office

actions.text: Land office: 12 lots staked, 12 for sale at 6 wood each; 612 of 676 lots still free, so the price climbs as the map fills. Buy: claim goal #9 and give the wood into my vault. Register your own plot for 5 wood: goal #7.

reasons: the lot price moved from 5 to 6 wood: the old listing comes down
the lot listing stands in public at today's price of 6 wood
the office line: lots staked and for sale, today's price, the fee
